subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, "LAMP" is written as "66" and "OATS" is written as "53". How will "YESS" be written in that language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f06e68a44022c54290efa51afe7a0dac55c73922f37af20a6e57947c71184bd.png] 

**Logic: **Code = (Addition of the opposite letters)

"LAMP" is written as "66" →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1eb3f9fb0c3196d1b66eb5a9f6f13228da7ff9e1c83e23a78949d4bb1656d2e.png] 

"OATS" is written as "53" →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f27b3cc85b6ac9e4855fe3132e9efc8747934643941f30653bc39be97204dea7.png] 

Similarly, "YESS" will be coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93f08697547a48bbf089751d9576f801f27b91a1867b90429b78c867dc6090a4.png] 

Here, 'YESS' is coded as **'40'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
